verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an official MCP server that brings its behavioral data into AI tools such as Claude, Cursor and OpenAI to get answers. It also offers REST APIs that return dashboard chart data as JSON and export event data, so an agent has first-party paths to product data. The evidence does not show which query tools or operations the MCP server exposes, or that agents can run arbitrary ad-hoc queries on live data. missing for 10: documentation of MCP query tools and their scope, evidence of ad-hoc query execution against live data via API or MCP, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents answering growth questions.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent answer growth questions from live product data by running queries through the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Bring Amplitude’s behavioral context directly into your AI tools—Claude, Cursor, OpenAI, Lovable, Figma, and more—to get answers where you work.
Start a conversation about your users or product and get expert-level answers in seconds that you can share with your whole org.
official MCP server documented at https://amplitude.com/mcp-server
Get data that's displayed on the dashboard graphs in JSON format through the Dashboard REST API.
